    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :hidden, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :text, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_everyone_else, :boolean, expr(is_distinct_from(hidden, true)),
      public?: false,
      description: "The Bubble \"everyone else\" rule applies: none of the rules hidden_ holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_mine, :boolean, expr(creator_id == ^actor(:id)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Mine\" (mine_): its condition holds"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_mine)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_everyone_else)
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_mine)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_everyone_else)
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :hidden, :text] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_mine)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_everyone_else)
    end
  end
end

  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,

  postgres do
    table "user"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do

      primary_key?: true,

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_rule_me, :boolean, expr(id == ^actor(:id)),
      public?: false,

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"

  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before

defmodule MyApp do
  use Ash.Domain

  resources do
    resource MyApp.Doc
    resource MyApp.Memo
    resource MyApp.Note
    resource MyApp.Team
    resource MyApp.User
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy do
  @moduledoc """
  Privacy rules compiled from Bubble to Ash policies by bubble_ex (WTF-356).

  NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE. The policies rest on Bubble semantics not
  yet confirmed by replaying the app (WTF-384/385): do not ship them to
  users until they are. See `verified?/0`.
  """

  @doc "Whether the generated policies are verified against Bubble: not yet."
  def verified?, do: false

  @doc "The relationships of the actor that the policies read."
  def actor_loads, do: []

  @doc "The resource of the actor (Bubble's User)."
  def actor_resource, do: MyApp.User

  @doc """
  Reads the actor (a user or a user ID) afresh with `actor_loads/0`,
  bypassing authorization: the policies must see its current values.
  Call it on every request and LiveView mount, never reuse a stored
  actor. Returns nil (logged out) for nil or an unknown ID.
  """
  def load_actor(nil), do: nil
  def load_actor(%{id: id}), do: load_actor(id)

  def load_actor(id) when is_binary(id) do
    case Ash.get(MyApp.User, id, load: actor_loads(), authorize?: false) do
      {:ok, actor} -> actor
      {:error, _} -> nil
    end
  end
end
